name: How Martyrs are Born
source:
A visual novel about love in the World of Darkness, portraying two sides that are opposite but equally attractive.

Each achievement represents one of the 7 possible endings, and your choices as Aurora can change your unlife, or even the world. Enjoy the journey while finding out “How Martyrs are Born”!

[From [url=https://tati-malkaviangel.itch.io/how-martyrs-are-born]Itch.io[/url]]
